en.title: Convert your USDC.noble
en.body: Noble is leaving Circle on {deadline}, after which Noble USDC can no longer be bridged or redeemed through Circle's standard routes. Convert your {symbols} to USDC 1:1.
en.afterDeadline: Noble is no longer supported by Circle's standard routes. Convert your {symbols} to USDC 1:1.
en.lateUnlock: After {deadline}, Noble USDC can only be redeemed through Circle's manual process, which may be slow.
